title: Program to Prevent Osteoporosis in Girls
brief_summary: Osteoporosis is a condition defined by decreased bone mass. Osteoporosis generally affects older women and can lead to bone fractures. One way to prevent osteoporosis is to build strong, healthy bones during childhood. This study will evaluate a program designed to improve girls' bones. The program encourages eating foods rich in calcium and participating in physical activity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Member of a Girl Scout troop with at least eight 5th grade girls
* Member of the Greater Minneapolis or St. Croix Valley Girl Scout organization
* Only troops with unanimous parental consent will be included in the trial
